problem: A deterministic planning score can prove structural completeness but cannot decide whether the shape and plan cohere, while an unbounded semantic reviewer can prevent shipping forever.
appetite: One bounded authority layer spanning schema, domain, CLI, MCP, skill, visualization, migration, and live proof.
smallest_slice: Persist one explicit shape disposition and one independent two-plus-one planning-review ledger ahead of implementation admission.
success_signal: A clean agent can inspect the ordered authority, approve or redirect planning in at most three passes, and implementation remains held until approval.
reversibility: Disable enforcement while retaining the new records; planning health and behavior verification remain intact.
decision_owner: Issue owner or named human approver

risks.risk: The planning reviewer becomes another endless loop.
risks.mitigation: Use stable findings, two repair-aware passes, a decision-only third pass, and reject pass four.
